'''Raeleene Nimsiik''' was a [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] from [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. During the [[Dantooine Incursion]], Nimsiik's family [[Farm/Legends|farm]] was saved by [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]]. The Commander's heroism inspired Nimsiik's daughter to join the [[Dantooine Militia]].<ref name="Pirate" />
